# `freebox_profiles` (Data Source)

Get the list of Freebox profiles (as seen under Freebox OS network control / parental control settings).

## Example

```terraform
data "freebox_profiles" "all" {}

output "profiles" {
  value = data.freebox_profiles.all.profiles
}
```
